description: This PHP source file defines the class MicrosoftOAuthProviderConnector, which extends ExternalOAuthProviderConnector. It implements OAuth2 provider-specific methods for Microsoft, including retrieving provider type, extra parameters, and mapping access tokens. The file also includes licensing information, entry point validation, and class method implementations relevant for OAuth integration within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: MicrosoftOAuthProviderConnector
classes.description: A class extending ExternalOAuthProviderConnector to handle OAuth2 interactions specific to Microsoft within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: getProviderType
methods.description: Returns the provider type identifier 'Microsoft' for OAuth configuration purposes.

methods.name: getExtraProviderParams
methods.description: Provides additional provider parameters, merging defaults with parent class parameters.

methods.name: mapAccessToken
methods.description: Maps the AccessTokenInterface object to an array of token parameters, using a dynamic mapping and default values.
